entries.root_cause: The recovery-proxy preflight audited only routines whose owner was exactly jlmirror_wave4_recovery_authority. A different non-superuser principal with immediately inherited recovery-role USAGE could own a callable or trigger-bound SECURITY DEFINER wrapper and dynamically exercise the newly granted cross-tenant recovery entry points, bypassing both exact-owner scans.
horizontal_audit: member-owned retained trigger and expression dependencies
non-inheriting memberships that require explicit SET ROLE
future grants to shared capability roles with inheriting members

entries.root_cause: The recovery-authority proxy audit constrained effective use of the shared recovery role but did not constrain delegation authority. A direct membership carrying ADMIN OPTION could grant jlmirror_wave4_recovery_authority onward to arbitrary principals after the bridge added two cross-tenant recovery entry points, recreating an authority expansion path despite function-level grant-option hardening.
horizontal_audit: transitive principals that can SET ROLE to an admin-capable delegate
existing non-delegable INHERIT and NOINHERIT memberships
future capability-role grants that add privileged entry points
